baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive event clause, the singular cry, the sudden fa-idha transition, jamic, and the passive causative muhdarun.
baseline_models.mechanism: One bounded acoustic event collapses a dispersed plurality into complete, proximate presence. The verse compresses trigger, convergence, and arrival into a single state transition.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time make the clause an event realization rather than a static description.
The raised sound supplies the sharply bounded trigger that can reach the whole plurality at once.
Numerical oneness removes any staged or repeated triggering from the compressed mechanism.
Joining what was dispersed supplies the convergence caused by the single signal.
Presence, witnessed proximity, and arrival supply the terminal state of the convergence.

changed_reading.before: A loud sound is followed by a crowd appearing.
changed_reading.after: A single bounded signal instantaneously converts dispersed plurality into complete presence at one proximal endpoint.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular alarming cry, jamic, ladayna, and the passive causative form muhdarun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cry functions as a universal summons: it puts every subject under one direction and causes the complete body to attend an authoritative hearing rather than merely congregate.

activation_trace.role: The alarming cry supplies an urgent summons rather than neutral ambient sound.
Union in one direction supplies the common orientation imposed on all who hear.
A call, day, or place that gathers people supplies the summons-and-assembly frame.
Attendance in contest or dispute before authority supplies the hearing-like function of being brought near.

changed_reading.before: Everyone is collected near the speaker.
changed_reading.after: Everyone is compelled by one summons into a complete audience before the authority marked by ladayna.

context_deltas.mechanism: The complete audience is also a closed evidentiary roll call: inscription and exhaustive enumeration preserve each subject's record, intended action supplies the basis of recompense, and knowledgeable testimony makes attendance adjudicative.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness without missing parts makes the assembled population a closed and complete docket.
Attendance in a dispute before authority gives the complete gathering an adjudicative function.
Entering a name in a register or cohort supplies the record structure behind a universal roll call.
Encircling totality supplies the no-omission scope of the recorded material.
Counting by exhaustive enumeration makes total attendance auditable rather than merely visual.
Deliberate action supplies the individualized matter evaluated immediately after presentation.
Knowledge-based declaration supplies an evidentiary voice within the assembled hearing.

structural_cues: 36:12 records what was sent ahead and exhaustively enumerates every thing.
The focus places the complete assembly ladayna, and 36:54 immediately ties the day to what each self did.
36:65 turns bodily members into speakers and witnesses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exhaustive register, intended actions, and testimony; I infer that caused attendance is a roll call for adjudication and that each attendee arrives with recoverable evidence. A live alternative is that gathering merely precedes, rather than itself constitutes, the hearing.

changed_reading.before: All persons form a complete crowd.
changed_reading.after: All persons are entered into a complete, auditable audience in which no subject or actionable trace can remain absent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact single-cry frame is reused with opposite terminal predicates. At 36:29 it stills animated plurality; at the focus it converts plurality into gathered presence. The cry is therefore a reversible state-switching operator, not merely a resurrection sound.

activation_trace.role: The raised sound is the focus-side carrier of the repeated transition formula.
Joining dispersed persons supplies the focus formula's positive terminal state.
Proximate presence completes the focus-side reversal from absence or stillness.
The same raised sound supplies the shared causal carrier in the earlier formula.
The same numerical singularity fixes both transitions to one bounded event.
Life or awareness stilled after movement supplies the earlier formula's opposite terminal state.

structural_cues: 36:29 and 36:53 share the full frame in kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan fa-idha hum.
Only the predicate after hum changes, from khamidun to jamic ladayna muhdarun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact syntactic recurrence and opposite result branches; I infer one transition template whose direction is set by divine use. A live alternative is that the two clauses describe distinct cries with unrelated functions.

changed_reading.before: The cry only wakes and gathers the dead.
changed_reading.after: The same one-event template can extinguish active life or reverse quiescence into total presence, displaying control over both directions of the state change.

context_deltas.mechanism: Historical cohorts that cannot return to one another are nevertheless synchronized before one endpoint. The focus gathering crosses temporal separation, not only geographic dispersion.

activation_trace.role: Joining dispersed persons anchors the focus as the convergence that overcomes cohort separation.
One proximal presence supplies the common endpoint shared by otherwise noncoeval groups.
People conjoined within one era supply the temporally bounded cohorts that the focus must reunite across eras.
Return to a prior state supplies the locally denied movement between earlier cohorts and the present audience.
Encircling totality expands the claim from particular destroyed cohorts to every cohort.
The earlier refrain explicitly joins the temporally dispersed population into one collected whole.
The repeated proximal attendance supplies the same endpoint later realized by the focus cry.

structural_cues: 36:31 denies that destroyed earlier generations return to the present people.
36:32 immediately answers with kull, jamic, ladayna, and muhdarun.
36:53 repeats the 36:32 attendance formula after introducing the one cry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies era-bound cohorts, denied return between them, and then universal attendance; I infer that the focus aligns noncoeval populations in one present. A live alternative is that 36:31 only illustrates mortality and 36:32 universalizes independently.

changed_reading.before: People scattered across places are gathered.
changed_reading.after: Generations separated by historical time are made co-present, so the one cry synchronizes eras as well as locations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered cosmos keeps distinct trajectories from overtaking one another while each moves in its course. The focus then supplies a singular phase-aligning event in which separated trajectories catch up and terminate in one attendance.

activation_trace.role: Things united in one direction supply the common orientation imposed by the single event.
Parts gathering force or speed until they catch up supplies the focus-side phase convergence.
Shared proximal presence supplies the synchronized endpoint.
Catching and reaching supply the overtaking relation that normal cosmic order withholds.
Precedence and racing supply the phase relation kept stable before the final convergence.
The celestial course supplies distinct recurring trajectories rather than static separation.
Running or swimming supplies continuous motion within those separated trajectories.

structural_cues: 36:40 denies mutual overtaking while placing every body in a moving course.
The focus combines one direction, suddenness, total gathering, and one endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies phase-separated motion and a focus branch in which moving parts catch up; I infer eschatological gathering as synchronization of trajectories. A live alternative is that the astronomical passage demonstrates governance without modeling the gathering's mechanics.

changed_reading.before: A static population is collected into one place.
changed_reading.after: Continuously moving and temporally separated trajectories are phase-aligned by one event into simultaneous attendance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Air sent into the horn stirs sleepers from grave-stillness and produces rapid directed movement toward their Lord; the focus muhdarun names the completed endpoint. The sudden clause telescopes a mobilization sequence rather than requiring static teleportation.

activation_trace.role: The raised sound condenses the acoustic initiation of the immediately preceding movement sequence.
Arrival into witnessed proximity supplies the endpoint of the directed movement.
Sending air into something supplies the physical initiation of the acoustic signal.
The blowing horn supplies the signal's instrument.
The grave supplies the distributed starting locations from which the population emerges.
Rapid forward motion supplies the directed transit between graves and attendance.
Stirring what was stationary supplies the transition from repose into movement.
Sleep and stillness supply the state rejected when the population is mobilized.

structural_cues: 36:51 gives a source-to-goal path from graves toward their Lord.
36:51 and 36:53 both use fa-idha hum to compress the transition.
36:52 inserts awakened recognition between rapid emergence and completed presentation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies horn, graves, stirring, and directed rapid movement; I infer that the focus completes that same trajectory and compresses its duration. A live alternative is that 36:53 introduces a distinct second signal rather than restating the 36:51 process.

changed_reading.before: The cry makes everyone appear at the endpoint without an articulated path.
changed_reading.after: The cry telescopes a horn-driven emergence and rapid approach whose completed state is universal attendance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal gathering is an intake operation, not permanent homogenization. Each self remains an accountable unit, and the complete set is subsequently separated by moral status.

activation_trace.role: Completion without omission supplies exhaustive jurisdiction while leaving internal distinctions available.
Attendance before authority supplies the common staging point from which judgment can distinguish parties.
The self as the thing itself supplies the irreducible individual unit inside the universal set.
Deliberate action supplies the criterion by which gathered selves remain distinguishable.
Sorting until one thing is distinct from another supplies the post-gathering partition.
Wrongdoing and crime supply the named class produced by the separation.

structural_cues: 36:54 shifts immediately from everyone present to each self and what it did.
36:59 directly commands the criminals to separate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive attendance, individual accountability, and later sorting; I infer that convergence creates a jurisdictional set whose members are then differentiated. A live alternative is that the command to separate is rhetorical classification rather than a spatial or procedural partition.

changed_reading.before: All are merged into one undifferentiated crowd.
changed_reading.after: No one escapes the universal intake, but gathering preserves each self so the complete set can be accurately partitioned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing command-to-occurrence formula makes voiced direction performative: a determinate object is commanded and becomes. The focus's one cry can therefore be heard as an efficacious summons whose utterance institutes universal attendance, not merely announces it.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time anchor the focus result as an instituted state.
Raised voice supplies the audible form through which the summons can operate.
One utterance in number supplies the economy of the performative act.
Demand and binding command supply the directive force behind the closing speech-to-result formula.
Will attached to a thing supplies the determinate object whose state the command changes.
The paired imperative and occurrence forms make commanded becoming the explicit result pattern.

structural_cues: 36:82 places command, saying, kun, and fayakun in one causal clause.
Both 36:53 and 36:82 use idha to compress direction and realized occurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding command, a determinate object, speech, and becoming; I infer that the focus cry participates in this performative causality. A live alternative is that the horn is only a signal that initiates an independently caused bodily process.

changed_reading.before: A sound notifies already re-created people to assemble.
changed_reading.after: One voiced command constitutes the new social and spatial state in which every subject stands present.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the running branch of h-d-r is distant from the ordinary attendance sense of muhdarun. It remains anchored in the focus's causative passive form and is activated by rapid grave-to-Lord motion plus the later contrast with blocked forward passage. Downstream prose should present it as a kinetic side-image of compelled attendance, not as a replacement lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive causative muhdarun names people made to reach attendance after one signal.

activation_trace.role: Making an animal run supplies a branch-distant kinetic image for causatively induced attendance.
Rapid forward motion supplies the visible movement that activates the focus root's running side-image.
Forward passage supplies the locomotion later imagined as blockable, sharpening the contrast with signal-induced motion.

changed_reading.before: Subjects are carried statically into attendance.
changed_reading.after: The signal can be imagined as inducing a compelled rapid run whose endpoint is presence before the authority.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the sonorous-cracking branch of s-y-h and the material-reassembly mechanism are form-distant, and the focus never explicitly names bones. It remains valid as an activation because cracking, gathering dispersed parts, complete presence, decayed bone, and renewed creation form one anchored mechanism. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy, not claim that sayhah lexically means bodily reconstruction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins the cry's cracking side-image to gathering, completeness, and caused presence.

activation_trace.role: Sonorous splitting supplies the branch-distant rupture image that initiates material reconfiguration.
Joining what was dispersed supplies reassembly rather than mere crowd formation.
Full presence supplies the terminal condition of reconstructed persons.
Solid bone supplies the concrete bodily material placed under the question of renewed life.
Decay and worn remains supply the fragmented material condition that gathering must overcome.
Bringing a thing newly into being supplies the reconstructive arrow from remains to complete presence.

changed_reading.before: The cry summons intact persons who already exist outside their graves.
changed_reading.after: The cry can evoke a rupture-and-reassembly event in which decayed bodily material is gathered into persons made wholly present.

strongest_changes: The exact 36:29 mirror turns the one-cry clause into a bidirectional state-switching formula: quenching there, total presence here.
The 36:51-53 sequence changes instantaneous appearance into a compressed path from horn and graves through rapid movement to completed attendance.
The register, individual action, testimony, and later separation change jamic from an undifferentiated crowd into exhaustive but discriminating jurisdiction.
The 36:31-32 sequence extends gathering across generations that cannot return to one another.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed three decisive recurrences around the focus: the earlier single-cry extinction formula, the earlier universal-attendance refrain, and the immediate horn-to-grave movement sequence. Together with the closing command-to-occurrence clause, they made one, all, and present operate as reversal, synchronization, and adjudication rather than simple crowd imagery.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not force whether the focus cry is identical with the horn blast, a compressed restatement of it, or a distinct second signal.
The adjudicative model may describe the purpose of being brought present rather than the lexical content of muhdarun itself.
The orbital synchronization, induced-run, and material-reassembly readings are controlled analogical activations, not direct lexical substitutions.
